{{recipe}}

'''Vegetarian pate''' is a hearty recipe that can be used as a dip or spread. Sweet peas are a good source of protein and Vitamin A, while the walnuts are jammed with omega-3 essential fatty acids.  

== Ingredients ==
*1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]] 
*1 can [[Cookbook:Pea|sweet peas]] 
*⅛ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] (1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]]) [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*⅛ teaspoon (1 pinch) [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]] 
*⅛ teaspoon (1 pinch) ground [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]] 
== Equipment ==

* Pot
* Hand-held [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] or [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]]

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] onion with walnuts in a pot for about 5 minutes.
# In a different bowl, combine sweet peas, salt, black pepper and cumin. Mix the ingredients well.
# Add the sweet pea mixture to the onion and walnuts, and continue sautéing for about 3 more minutes.
#Turn off the heat and let cool. [[Cookbook:Puréeing|Purée]] with a hand-held blender or in food processor until you achieve a creamy, though slightly nutty texture similar to that of pate or dip.
#Serve with crackers, bread, baby carrots and other snack type vegetables.

steps.text: Sauté onion with walnuts in a pot for about 5 minutes.
In a different bowl, combine sweet peas, salt, black pepper and cumin. Mix the ingredients well.
Add the sweet pea mixture to the onion and walnuts, and continue sautéing for about 3 more minutes.
Turn off the heat and let cool. Purée with a hand-held blender or in food processor until you achieve a creamy, though slightly nutty texture similar to that of pate or dip.
Serve with crackers, bread, baby carrots and other snack type vegetables.
